nodes.name: Copywriting Formulas
nodes.summary: Reference of 25 persuasive copywriting formulas for slide writing, including PAS, AIDA, FAB, Cost of Inaction, and Before-After-Bridge. Maps formulas to slide types and emotions, provides headline patterns, and quick-reference lookup tables.

nodes.name: Slides Create Command
nodes.summary: Command template for invoking the slides skill to create persuasive HTML slides using design tokens, Chart.js, and the slide knowledge database.

nodes.name: HTML Slide Template
nodes.summary: Complete HTML boilerplate for slide decks including 16:9 responsive container, navigation controls, Chart.js integration, CSS animation classes (fade-up, scale, stagger), background image patterns, and CSS variable references for theming.

nodes.name: Layout Patterns
nodes.summary: Reference of 25 slide layout patterns with CSS structures, animation classes, card variants, metric styles, and visual treatments. Includes layout selection matrix, responsive breakpoints, and decision flow logic.

nodes.name: Slide Strategies
nodes.summary: Reference of 15 proven presentation deck structures (YC Seed, Sales Pitch, Product Demo, etc.) with emotion arcs, slide counts, audience targeting, and the Duarte Sparkline pattern for persuasive storytelling.
